name: fig3_expression
description: Fig 3 — gene expression dynamics: stochastic transcription/translation/decay producing bursty mRNA and accumulating protein across the representative gene panel.

seed.description: Random seed for the stochastic expression

transcription.doc:
Stochastic transcription — reduced reproduction of Karr 2012 Transcription.
For each gene g on the representative panel, new mRNA per step is a Poisson draw
    n_g ~ Poisson(k_g · (RNApol / RNApol_ref) · Δt)
capped by NTP supply (each transcript consumes length_g NTP; PPi released). Keeps the essential stochastic single-molecule synthesis mechanism of the full RNA-polymerase state machine.
Contract — in: ntp (pool, molecules), rna_pol (available polymerase count). out: rna_counts (per-gene mRNA Δ, additive map), ntp (Δ consumed, negative).
Fidelity: REDUCED — a 6-gene representative panel with representative rates, not all ~480 genes; reproduces the qualitative bursty-mRNA behaviour of Fig 2G.

translation.doc:
Stochastic translation — reduced reproduction of Karr 2012 Translation.
For each gene g, new protein per step is Poisson in the current mRNA copy number
    n_g ~ Poisson(r_g · mRNA_g · Δt)
capped by GTP supply (~2 GTP per peptide bond, ≈ gtp_per_protein per chain). Keeps the mRNA-proportional, GTP-limited synthesis of the full ribosome state machine.
Contract — in: rna_counts (per-gene mRNA copies), gtp (pool, molecules). out: protein_counts (per-gene protein Δ, additive map), gtp (Δ consumed, negative).
Fidelity: REDUCED — representative panel; drives the Fig 2G/2H mRNA↔protein decoupling and the translation share of the Fig 5 energy budget.

rna_decay.doc:
Stochastic mRNA decay — reproduction of Karr 2012 RNADecay.
Each species s degrades as a Poisson process at rate ln2 / half-life:
    decayed_s ~ min(n_s, Poisson(n_s · λ_s · Δt))
setting steady-state copy numbers together with transcription.
Contract — in/out: rna_counts (per-gene mRNA; a negative-Δ map).
Fidelity: REDUCED — species-level Poisson decay on the representative panel (NMP salvage/water accounting of the original omitted).

emitter.doc:
Store historical states in memory.

``subsample`` records only every Nth composite tick (default 1 =
every tick). Use this for long runs or composites with heavy
state (large fields, many agents) to keep RAM bounded — the
saved time-series still reflects the simulation's true cadence
via each row's ``global_time`` field.

``max_len`` optionally bounds ``history`` to the most recent N
recorded rows (a ring buffer): once the cap is reached each new
record drops the oldest. Default ``None`` = unbounded (the
historical behaviour — consumers such as v2ecoli that read the
full ``history`` are unaffected unless they opt in). ``max_len``
counts *recorded* rows (i.e. post-``subsample``).
